*Example*

.Before
[source,java]
----
import ai.docling.serve.api.DoclingServeApi;
import ai.docling.serve.client.DoclingServeClientBuilderFactory;

class Demo {
    DoclingServeApi create() {
        return DoclingServeClientBuilderFactory.newBuilder()
                .baseUrl("http://localhost:5001")
                .build();
    }

    DoclingServeApi copy(DoclingServeApi api) {
        return api.toBuilder().logRequests().build();
    }
}
----

.After
[source,java]
----
import ai.docling.serve.api.DoclingServeApi;
import ai.docling.serve.client.DoclingServeClient;

class Demo {
    DoclingServeApi create() {
        return DoclingServeClient.builder()
                .baseUrl("http://localhost:5001")
                .build();
    }

    DoclingServeApi copy(DoclingServeApi api) {
        return api.config().toBuilder().logRequests().build();
    }
}
----

[#io_arconia_rewrite_docling_UseDoclingServeApiConfigToBuilder]
=== Use `DoclingServeApi.config().toBuilder()` instead of `toBuilder()`
`io.arconia.rewrite.docling.UseDoclingServeApiConfigToBuilder`

Replace the deprecated `DoclingServeApi.toBuilder()` with `config().toBuilder()`, which creates a modified copy of the API through the available `DoclingServeApiProvider`.

*Example*

.Before
[source,java]
----
import ai.docling.serve.api.DoclingServeApi;

class Demo {
    DoclingServeApi copy(DoclingServeApi api) {
        return api.toBuilder().logRequests().build();
    }
}
----

.After
[source,java]
----
import ai.docling.serve.api.DoclingServeApi;

class Demo {
    DoclingServeApi copy(DoclingServeApi api) {
        return api.config().toBuilder().logRequests().build();
    }
}
----
